# noqeri/core 0.5.0

Retains all v0.4.0 public APIs and module files while adding 20 usable Noqeri helper algorithms from the original MIT 0.1.1 preview. Includes bounded byte utilities, parsing/conversion helpers, predictable errors and operation guards. Module paths from 0.4.0 remain; no Node.js runtime dependency.

The original implementation is GPL-3.0-only; supplemented code is MIT-licensed with full notice in LICENSE-MIT. Regression source included; cross-target execution is not yet verified.
